project.objective: Establish the baptism date of Sarah Hollins of Bolton, Lancashire, daughter of William Hollins, from the parish register and its later transcript

questions.question: Was Sarah Hollins baptised at Bolton-le-Moors on 14 February 1746 or 14 February 1747?
questions.rationale: Two sources give the same day and month for the baptism but years one apart. Whether this is a genuine disagreement or an artifact of how the year was reckoned must be settled before either date is carried into the tree.

items.rationale: The Bolton-le-Moors Anglican register should record the baptism directly; the printed transcript gives a second reading of the same entry.

log.notes: Two readings of one baptism. The register image gives the year as 1746; the printed transcript gives 1747. Same day (14 February), same month, same parish, same father.

sources.citation: Bolton-le-Moors, Lancashire, England, Anglican parish register, baptisms, entry for Sarah Hollins, 14 February 1746; digital image, FamilySearch.org, accessed 2 May 2026.
sources.notes: The register's own year, as written by the curate on the page.

sources.citation: Lancashire Parish Register Society, printed transcript of Bolton-le-Moors baptisms, entry for Sarah Hollins, 14 February 1747; FamilySearch.org, accessed 2 May 2026.

citation_detail.what: Printed transcript of the Bolton-le-Moors baptism register

sources.notes: A later transcript of the same register entry. It gives the year as 1747.
